name: Mousework Indicator
description:
Shows the status of a SteelSeries Rival 3 Wireless in the top bar while it is connected through its USB receiver.

Features:
- Battery level, with an icon that shows the charge and whether it is charging
- Active DPI and which preset is in use
- Polling rate, and whether high-efficiency mode is on
- Switch between your Mousework profiles from the menu
- Shows when the mouse is asleep and while settings are syncing to it
- Choose the top-bar icon and which values appear next to it
- Opens the Mousework app from the menu

Needs Mousework (https://github.com/mlkonrad/mousework), which talks to the mouse. If it isn't installed, the indicator says so and links to the installation guide.
